statistical_sizing.n_positive_operational_note: Operational positive = SUPPORTED only. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED maps to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (fail-closed), so it is treated as negative in binary evaluation.
statistical_sizing.n_negative_operational_note: Operational negative = PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED (10) + IN_DOMAIN_CORPUS_COVERAGE_GAP (20) + OUT_OF_DOMAIN_UNSUPPORTED (20) + DIFFICULT_PERTURBATION_NEGATIVE (20). The unsafe-accept rate denominator is 70.
statistical_sizing.partially_supported_operational_policy: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED labels map to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (fail-closed). They count as operational negatives in binary evaluation even though they were originally designed as a positive sub-stratum.
statistical_sizing.claim: 0 observed unsafe accepts on operational negatives (n=70) yields a one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of 4.19% <= 5.00%. The unsafe-accept CI denominator is 70 (operational), not 60 (designed).
